summary: Vale S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing its interim consolidated financial statements for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing reports routine quarterly results, including net operating revenue, income, cash flows, and balance sheet data, with no mention of any special-situation event such as a merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or activist campaign. The actions described are standard financial reporting by a foreign private issuer, with no extraordinary corporate event disclosed.
